snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 100 - The Uchuuhikoushi (2002)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Uchuuhikoushi is an Action game, developed by Amedio and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2002.
